The '''Rakton campaign''' was a military campaign conducted by the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that targeted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]]. After the [[Battle of the Gauntlet]], Rakton attacked the Republic in force, and [[Havoc Squad]] carried out a number of missions to foil Rakton's plans before defeating him at the [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]].
